name: messidor1
citation: Decencière et al., 'Feedback on a Publicly Distributed Image Database: The Messidor Database', Image Anal Stereol 2014.
notes: DEPRECATED: ADCIS withdrew MESSIDOR-1 in 2018. Use `messidor2` (already in EyeDataHub) instead. Kept for reproducing pre-2018 benchmark papers.

name: e_ophtha
full_name: E-ophtha (EX + MA): Exudate and Microaneurysm Segmentation
citation: Decencière et al., 'TeleOphta: Machine Learning and Image Processing Methods for Teleophthalmology', IRBM 2013.
notes: Official source (ADCIS) requires a request form. EyeDataHub uses the Kaggle community mirror. Verify license terms with the original ADCIS distribution before commercial use.

name: roc
license: Research only (free for research, University of Iowa)
citation: Niemeijer et al., 'Retinopathy Online Challenge: Automatic Detection of Microaneurysms in Digital Color Fundus Photographs', IEEE TMI 2010.
notes: University of Iowa registration form required — no auto path.

name: drions_db
full_name: DRIONS-DB: Digital Retinal Images for Optic Nerve Segmentation
citation: Carmona et al., 'Identification of the Optic Nerve Head with Genetic Algorithms', Artificial Intelligence in Medicine 2008.
notes: UNED host serves an expired SSL certificate as of 2026-07. EyeDataHub falls back to an unverified HTTPS request; set PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY=0 in your environment if requests still fails cert validation. Distributed as .rar — needs `unrar` (Linux: `apt install unrar`; macOS: `brew install rar`; Windows: 7-Zip).

name: rite
full_name: RITE: Retinal Images Vessel Tree Extraction (Artery/Vein)
citation: Hu et al., 'Automated Separation of Binary Overlapping Trees in Low-Contrast Color Retinal Images', MICCAI 2013.
notes: Iowa Qualtrics form gates download — no auto path.

name: fire
citation: Hernandez-Matas et al., 'FIRE: Fundus Image Registration Dataset', Journal of Modeling in Ophthalmology 2017.
notes: FORTH host serves an expired SSL cert as of 2026-07. Set REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/bundle or PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY=0. Distributed as 7z — extract with 7-Zip / `7z x FIRE.7z`.

name: dr_hagis
full_name: DR-HAGIS: DR, Hypertension, AMD, Glaucoma Image Set
citation: Holm et al., 'DR-HAGIS — A Fundus Image Database for the Automatic Extraction of Retinal Surface Vessels from Diabetic Patients', J. Medical Imaging 2017.
notes: STALE LINK: Original Manchester URL returns 404 as of 2026-06. Try contacting the author or searching for community mirrors before relying on this entry.

name: riga
full_name: RIGA: Retinal Fundus Images for Glaucoma Analysis
citation: Almazroa et al., 'Retinal Fundus Images for Glaucoma Analysis: The RIGA Dataset', J. Medical Imaging 2018.
notes: Three sub-archives (BinRushed, Magrabi, MESSIDOR). The MESSIDOR sub-archive is large; if download fails, try the Academic Torrents mirror (infohash eb9dd9216a1c9a622250ad70a400204e7531196d).

name: lag
license: Research only (no redistribution; password by email)
citation: Li et al., 'Attention Based Glaucoma Detection: A Large-scale Database and CNN Model', CVPR 2019.
notes: Dropbox link gated by password — email liliu1995@buaa.edu.cn to request access. Cannot be auto-downloaded.

name: chaksu

name: hygd
citation: Hillel Yaffe Glaucoma Dataset, PhysioNet 2024 (v1.1.0). Labels gold-standardized via OCT + visual field.

name: smdg
